panels.title: P&L today
panels.description: IB daily P&L summed over positions (the attribution table's total)

panels.title: SPX move today
panels.description: SPX since the last close

panels.title: SPX delta
panels.description: Beta-weighted; one axis, SPX units. Green: SPX delta neutral (|beta delta $| within the band: a 1% SPX day costs at most delta_band_theta_days of theta, capped at delta_band_nav_pct of net liq). Orange: up to twice the band. Red: beyond.

targets.expr:
label_replace((sum(thetagang_delta_band_dollars) / sum(thetagang_spx_price)) * 0 - 1e15, "step", "base", "", "")
 or label_replace(-2 * (sum(thetagang_delta_band_dollars) / sum(thetagang_spx_price)), "step", "lo2", "", "")
 or label_replace(-1 * (sum(thetagang_delta_band_dollars) / sum(thetagang_spx_price)), "step", "lo1", "", "")
 or label_replace(1 * (sum(thetagang_delta_band_dollars) / sum(thetagang_spx_price)), "step", "hi1", "", "")
 or label_replace(2 * (sum(thetagang_delta_band_dollars) / sum(thetagang_spx_price)), "step", "hi2", "", "")

panels.title: Beta delta $
panels.description: Portfolio delta $ x beta: SPX delta x SPX price. +1% SPX ≈ 1% of this. Green: SPX delta neutral (|beta delta $| within the band: a 1% SPX day costs at most delta_band_theta_days of theta, capped at delta_band_nav_pct of net liq). Orange: up to twice the band. Red: beyond.

targets.expr:
label_replace(sum(thetagang_delta_band_dollars) * 0 - 1e15, "step", "base", "", "")
 or label_replace(-2 * sum(thetagang_delta_band_dollars), "step", "lo2", "", "")
 or label_replace(-1 * sum(thetagang_delta_band_dollars), "step", "lo1", "", "")
 or label_replace(1 * sum(thetagang_delta_band_dollars), "step", "hi1", "", "")
 or label_replace(2 * sum(thetagang_delta_band_dollars), "step", "hi2", "", "")

panels.title: Theta / day
panels.description: $ per day from time decay

panels.title: Vega / vol pt
panels.description: $ per 1 point of implied vol

panels.title: Volga / vol pt
panels.description: How much the portfolio's vega ($ per vol point) changes when implied vol rises one point

panels.title: Gamma P&L / day
panels.description: Realized: gamma's share of today's P&L so far (the attribution table's Gamma column). Expected: what an average day earns (+) or costs (-) from gamma alone, 1/2 x gamma x (move x SPX)^2, with the move from VIX (VIX / sqrt(252), about 1% at VIX 16): the expected P&L of staying delta neutral (negative when short gamma). Net carry: Theta / day + Expected: positive means being delta neutral pays you. Break-even: the daily SPX move where gamma's loss equals a day's theta.

panels.title: Account
panels.description: IB account values (old Account summary). Cushion = excess liquidity / net liquidation.

panels.title: Cushion
panels.description: Excess liquidity / net liquidation. IB liquidates at 0.

panels.title: Margin used
panels.description: Margin in use as a share of net liquidation

panels.title: Attention
panels.description: Positions without greeks (blocks new trades) + long options with |delta| >= long_option_alert_delta

panels.title: Data age
panels.description: Seconds since the monitor last refreshed

panels.title: Portfolio greeks (SPX beta-weighted)
panels.description: now: current book. after_proposals: after the SPX delta = 0 net target trades (display only). after_trades: after the trade plan (only while the trading strategy runs).

targets.expr: sum by (greek, scenario) (thetagang_greeks) or label_replace(sum by (greek) (thetagang_greeks_after_trades), "scenario", "after_trades", "", "")

panels.title: Stress P&L by SPX move
panels.description: Options repriced at current IV. Beta-weighted: each stock moves beta x the SPX move; All betas = 1: every stock moves with SPX.

panels.title: VIX hedge
panels.description: Long VIX calls held (beyond ignore_dte); the allocation for new buys at today's VIXMO (your [strategy.vix_call_hedge.allocation] bands, a share of net liq; 'no VIXMO' until VIXMO quotes); and the VIX level that sells them.

panels.title: Hedge
panels.description: What the VIX call hedge would do now.

panels.title: Beta delta $ by symbol
panels.description: What each symbol contributes to SPX delta

panels.title: Share of SPX exposure
panels.description: |Beta delta $| per symbol: where the market risk sits

panels.title: Daily P&L by symbol (attribution)
panels.description: IB's daily P&L per symbol. From SPX: beta delta $ x SPX move. Unexplained: P&L - From SPX. Delta: delta $ x the symbol's own move. Gamma: 1/2 gamma (dS)^2. Theta: one day of decay. Vega: vega x IV change since the day's first observation. Residual: the rest (today's trades, vanna/volga, dividends). P&L = Delta + Gamma + Theta + Vega + Residual.

panels.title: Symbols
panels.description: Net greeks of all stock and option positions per symbol

panels.title: Positions summary and SPX Δ=0 targets
panels.description: Targets for SPX delta = 0 and delta $ (no beta) = 0 (weighted least squares). Weight = |beta delta $| / sum of |beta delta $|; side = market side. Net target contracts resizes the position with the most delta, whole contracts, never flipping a position. Display only: no orders.

panels.title: Calls (standalone)
panels.description: Calls not in a vertical. Shorts: roll / close / keep by [roll_when]; take profit = buy back at or below this price per share (close_at_pnl). Longs: roll or close by hand once |delta| >= long_option_alert_delta. P&L: of the premium.

panels.title: Puts (standalone)
panels.description: Puts not in a vertical. Shorts: roll / close / keep by [roll_when]; take profit = buy back at or below this price per share (close_at_pnl). Longs: roll or close by hand once |delta| >= long_option_alert_delta. P&L: of the premium.

panels.title: Spreads (credit and debit verticals, one combo order each)
panels.description: Credit: roll / close by [roll_when], take profit = buy back at or below (close_at_pnl of the credit). Debit: close at or above the take-profit (debit_spread_take_profit of the max profit), roll near expiry. P&L: of the net credit / debit.

panels.title: Positions
panels.description: Every position, grouped by symbol like the old bot (stock first, then options by expiry). Und. price: the underlying's price (the stock itself for stock rows). Delta, gamma, theta, vega: per share, as IB quotes them (stock delta = 1); x 100 x Qty for the position.

panels.title: Trade plan (configured trades, sized to SPX Δ=0)
panels.description: Published by the trading strategy each run (empty while it isn't running). Contracts: whole units, never the wrong way, capped by max_contracts.

panels.title: Trade plan status
panels.description: Why the plan is what it is: within the band, positions without greeks, rolls this run, or SPX delta now -> after.

panels.title: VIX / VIXMO
panels.description: The hedge buys by VIXMO allocation and sells above close_hedges_when_vix_exceeds

panels.title: Orders placed (per hour)
panels.description: Dry-run orders are counted too
